name: ins-desk-prompt
description: Desk: an insured patient whose cover is not checked today gets a prompt, never a gate
The prompt opens Details, where the patient's cover is shown

assert: Boolean(document.querySelector('dialog[open]'))&&document.querySelector('dialog[open]').innerText.includes('Geneus never assumes how long a check lasts')
description: Recording a check asks only for the dates the payer confirmed

name: ins-desk-checked
description: The check is saved on this device and shown on the cover

name: ins-cashier-estimate
assert: (()=>{const t=document.querySelector('dialog[open]').innerText;return t.includes('Insurance estimate')&&/Patient pays NGN\s150\.00/.test(t)&&/Patient credit NGN\s850\.00/.test(t)&&t.includes('refunded once insurance for the charge is confirmed')&&/Amount due\s+NGN\s100\.00/.test(t);})()
description: Cashier: a verified patient owes only the co-pay; an earlier overpayment shows as a credit that waits for confirmation

name: ins-cashier-undetermined
assert: (()=>{const t=document.querySelector('dialog[open]').innerText;return t.includes('Awaiting an insurance decision')&&/NGN\s2,000\.00/.test(t)&&t.includes('Not part of the amount due')&&!/Amount due\n/.test(t)&&t.includes('Patient chooses to pay without insurance');})()
description: Cashier: unchecked cover is shown apart and never asked for; self-pay is offered because this contract allows it

click: Patient chooses to pay without insurance
assert: document.body.innerText.includes('The patient will owe the full')
description: Self-pay explains what the patient will owe

click: The patient agreed to pay without insurance

name: ins-cashier-selfpay
assert: (()=>{const t=document.querySelector('dialog[open]').innerText;return t.includes('Patient chose to pay without insurance')&&/Amount due\s+NGN\s2,000\.00/.test(t);})()
description: The recorded choice makes the full price due, and stays on the record

name: ins-officer-worklist
assert: (()=>{const t=document.body.innerText;return t.includes('Needs review (1)')&&t.includes('Paid more than the patient share')&&t.includes('Cover not checked')&&t.includes('Email me a verification code');})()
description: Officer: overpaid visits need review with a reason; unchecked cover is listed by reason; actions need verification
One code verifies the officer for every action until it expires

fill.label: Reason for your decision
fill.value: Synthetic: patient overpaid at the till; cover verified

name: ins-officer-confirmed
assert: (()=>{const t=document.body.innerText;return /2 charges confirmed/.test(t)&&t.includes('No exceptions.')&&/credit NGN\s850\.00/.test(t)&&!t.includes('refundable once confirmed');})()
description: Confirming the exception turns the overpayment into a final credit, ready to refund

name: ins-contracts
description: Payers and contracts open online for the officer
The active contract version is listed
Supervisor: a confirmed credit can be refunded
A refund needs the verified staff session

fill.label: Reason
fill.value: Synthetic overpayment handed back in cash

name: ins-refund
description: The refund settles the credit; the original payment still shows as received
